description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetGrainDirectory component in the Orleans framework, specifically targeting different SQL database implementations (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL). It defines test classes and methods to verify registration, unregistration, lookup, batch unregistration, and concurrency behavior of grain directory operations, with particular focus on database interactions and correctness of storage.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory against SQL Server.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetGrainDirectory against MySQL.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: Abstract base class defining common tests for AdoNetGrainDirectory across different databases, including register, unregister, lookup, batch unregister, and concurrency tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the storage testing environment before each test.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, currently a no-op.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_RegistersActivation
methods.description: Verifies that a grain activation can be registered correctly in the database.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_UnregistersActivation
methods.description: Verifies that a registered grain activation can be unregistered and removed from storage.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_LooksUpActivation
methods.description: Checks that a registered activation can be looked up successfully.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_UnregistersActivationsForSilos
methods.description: Ensures that activations for specific silos can be batch unregistered.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory_ChaosTest
methods.description: Performs a stress test with concurrent registrations and lookups to verify robustness under load.
